name: patient_has_finding_of_viral_hepatitis_c_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has hepatitis C virus infection.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has hepatitis C virus infection.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have hepatitis C virus infection.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has hepatitis C virus infection.

name: patient_hepatitis_c_virus_genotype_value_now_withunit_numeric
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current hepatitis C virus genotype.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current hepatitis C virus genotype is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's current hepatitis C virus genotype if known (e.g., 1 for genotype 1).
